name: Planche
description: A straight-arm hold balanced on the hands with the body level above the floor. It takes long, patient wrist and shoulder conditioning.

steps.label: Frog stand
steps.cue: Spread your fingers and lean forward until your feet float.

steps.label: Planche lean
steps.cue: Lean your shoulders past your wrists with your arms locked.

steps.label: Pseudo planche push-up
steps.cue: Keep the lean at the bottom; hands stay beside your waist.

steps.label: Tuck planche
steps.cue: Round your upper back and push the floor away.

steps.label: Advanced tuck planche
steps.cue: Flatten your back and lean further to balance.

steps.label: Straddle planche
steps.cue: Legs wide and straight, hips level with your shoulders.

steps.label: Full planche
steps.cue: Legs together, lean far, arms locked straight.
